arabic: سَجَدَ وَجْهِيَ لِلَّذِي خَلَقَهُ، وَشَقَّ سَمْعَهُ وَبَصَرَهُ بِحَوْلِهِ وَقُوَّتِهِ، (فَتَبَارَكَ اللهُ أَحْسَنُ الْخَالِقِينَ)
transliteration: Sajada wajhiya lillathee khalaqahu, washaqqa sam'ahu wabasarahu bihawlihi waquwwatihi, (fatabarakal-lahu ahsanul-khaliqeen).
translation: I have prostrated my face to the One Who created it, and made its hearing and vision, by His might and His power. (So Blessed is Allah, the best of creators).
